a_before_b.rationale: Identifying scalability bottlenecks in evaluation does not require first mastering how to define evaluation criteria; one can recognize cost, time, and annotation issues without knowing how to specify application behavior or out-of-scope inputs.

b_before_a.rationale: Defining evaluation criteria is a distinct design task that does not depend on understanding scalability bottlenecks such as high costs, time requirements, or lack of standardization in human annotation.
